units.source_text: 我想变成蜜蜂的眼睛继续观察。

en.t: I wanted to become the eyes of the bee and go on observing.

units.source_text: 我看见绽开的一点伤痕也没有的端正的黄菊花瓣，

en.t: I saw the perfectly formed yellow chrysanthemum petals opening without the slightest scar,

units.source_text: 简直像一座小金阁那样美，像金阁那样完整，

en.t: as beautiful as a little Golden Pavilion, as complete as the Golden Pavilion,

units.source_text: 但绝没有变形为金周，而仅仅是停留在夏菊的一朵上。

en.t: yet it had by no means transformed into a Golden Pavilion, but remained only as a single summer chrysanthemum.

units.source_text: 是啊，这是千真万确的菊花，是一种花儿，

en.t: Yes, this was unmistakably a chrysanthemum, a kind of flower,

units.source_text: 仅仅是停留在一种不含任何形而上的东西暗示的形态上。

en.t: remaining only in a form that contained no hint of anything metaphysical.

units.source_text: 它通过保持这样存在的节度，散发出一种迷惑，成为适合蜜蜂的欲望的东西。

en.t: By maintaining this restraint of existence, it gave off a kind of bewildering allure and became something suited to the bee's desire.

units.source_text: 在无形的、飞翔的、流动的、盛久的欲望面前，这样隐身在作为对象的形态里，喘着气息，这是多么神秘啊！

en.t: Before desire that was formless, flying, flowing, and long in its fullness, how mysterious it was to hide like this inside the form of an object and breathe there!

units.source_text: 形态渐渐变得稀薄，即将破裂，在不停地震颤。

en.t: The form gradually grew thin, trembling without cease as if about to burst.
There was a reason for this too.

units.source_text: 菊花的端庄形态，是模仿蜜蜂的欲望而制造出来的，

en.t: The chrysanthemum's graceful form had been made in imitation of the bee's desire,

units.source_text: 这种美本身是冲着预感而开花的，因此如今正是生的形态的意义在闪光的瞬间。

en.t: and this beauty itself had blossomed toward a premonition, so now was precisely the moment when the meaning of the form of life flashed into light.

units.source_text: 这形态是无形的流动的生的铸型，同时无形的生的飞翔也是这个世界上所有形态的铸型……

en.t: This form was the mold of formless, flowing life, while at the same time the flight of formless life was also the mold of every form in this world...

units.source_text: 蜜蜂一头钻进了花儿的深处，浑身沾满了花粉，沉湎在酩酊之中。

en.t: The bee plunged headfirst into the depths of the flower, its whole body covered in pollen, sinking into intoxication.

units.source_text: 我看见了迎进蜜蜂的夏菊花强烈地抖动着身子，

en.t: I saw the summer chrysanthemum that had taken in the bee shaking its body violently,

units.source_text: 它本身好像变成了穿着豪华的黄铠甲的蜜蜂，马上就要脱离花茎腾空而飞似的。

en.t: as if it itself had become a bee clad in splendid yellow armor and was about to leave the flower stem and fly into the air.
